0022600042.text: The LA Clippers host the Oklahoma City Thunder with the Clippers at 2-7, 2-3 at home and 0-4 on the road, sitting 13th in the West and 6.5 games back in the Pacific after a win in their most recent game. Oklahoma City comes in at 8-2, 5-0 at home and 3-2 on the road, on a four-game winning streak and first in the Northwest. In the season series, the Clippers trail 0-1 in 2026-27 after a 108-101 loss in Oklahoma City on October 25, and they were swept 0-3 by the Thunder in 2025-26. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Cam Christie (ankle), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Thunder are without Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture) and Thomas Sorber (knee).
